MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 15

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 26

3. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

5. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 2

6. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 1

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 10

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

9. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 73

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

11. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

15. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
